title: Go‑Live Prioritization Slate & Launch Heuristics
content:
Purpose:
This is a working-run document for the next product launch window (sprint + 2). It combines a lightweight KPI runway, a compact prioritization rubric (decision tiles) to pick the must-ship items, and a short set of launch heuristics + contingency playlets. Use this during triage meetings and the final go/no-go.

Scope and context:
- Scope: customer-facing feature set A (in-product routing + rollout flag), admin metrics surface, and a small console rollout for Beta customers.
- Goal: prioritize with a single, repeatable scoring method to decide what stays in the launch and what gets delayed to the 1.1 patch.
- Audience: product-ops, product manager, eng leads, SRE, solutions engineering.

How to use this doc (quick):
1) For each candidate workstream, complete the Decision Tile below.
2) Run the KPI runway section against current baselines and hit-rate projections.
3) Use the Risk-to-Value heuristic to finalize a short launch list (<= 3 product changes + console).
4) Capture owners and a single rollback/fallback per item before signoff.

DECISION TILE (one per feature/epic) - fill during triage
- Feature: [short name]
- Hypothesis (one sentence): what change to customer behavior or metric do we expect?
- Primary metric: [KPI name]
- Secondary metrics: [list]
- Baseline: [current value + date]
- Target (30 / 90 day): [value / rationale]
- Weighted score components (0-5 each):
  - Customer impact (0 none — 5 critical to primary use case)
  - Revenue/regulatory impact (0 none — 5 direct SLA/compliance or >$50k/mo)
  - Implementation risk (0 trivial — 5 high/unresolved infra work) *reverse-scored for priority*
  - Operational cost delta (0 reduces ops — 5 increases ops) *reverse-scored*
  - Time-to-value (0 >3 sprints — 5 rolling out within this sprint)
- Composite score formula: (Customer impact + Revenue impact + Time-to-value) - (Implementation risk + Ops cost) — range roughly -10 to +15.
- Canary plan outline: who, how much traffic, rollback trigger (metric threshold).
- Owner(s) + READY checklist (infra signoff, telemetry, alerts, regression tests).

KPI RUNWAY (compact sheet view) - paste into sprint review
Format (one line per KPI):
KPI | Baseline | 30d target | 90d target | Owner | Measurement cadence | Alert threshold
- Active API latency (p50 ms) | 110ms (2025-11-01) | 95ms | 85ms | Eng-SRE | daily | p95 > 350ms 3hrs
- Cost per 1k tokens (USD) | $28.50 (2025-10-31) | $24.00 | $19.00 | Eng-Serving-Runtime | weekly | >10% QoQ increase
- Avg. query success rate (200 OK ratio) | 98.6% | 99.2% | 99.5% | Eng-Platform | hourly | <97% 30m
- Beta customer NPS (in-product survey) | 6.2/10 | 7.4/10 | 7.8/10 | Solutions-Eng | rolling | drop >0.6 absolute
- Feature adoption (users/week touching feature) | 420 (2025-11-01) | 1,200 | 4,000 | PM | weekly | <10% wk/wk growth

RISK-TO-VALUE HEURISTIC (decision matrix)
- Green (High priority): Composite score >= 6 AND no unresolved infra blockers. Small canary and clear rollback.
- Amber (Consider): Composite score 2–5 OR depends on 1 external deliverable. Consider limited rollout to beta customers only.
- Red (Delay): Composite score < 2 OR any unresolved security/regulatory item or >2 infra blockers.

LAUNCH READINESS CHECKLIST (final signoff items)
- Product: UX copy locked, accessibility check, help center draft created, user communication plan (modal/email).
- Engineering: feature flag gating in place, infra autoscale verified, last-green smoke test, p95/p99 profiling on staging.
- Observability: metric instrumentation present for primary + fallback metrics, dashboards created, alert runbook attached, tracing context enabled.
- SRE/Infra: rollback plan written, capacity buffer validated (N+1 target), cold-start latency tests, DR playbook updated (small doc).
- Legal/Compliance: data flow diagram updated, PII checklist verified, privacy notice updated if required.
- Sales/CS: release notes draft, customer-facing FAQ, onboarding checklist for early adopters.

CONTINGENCY PLAYLETS (short, copyable into Slack/incident)
- Playlet A: Partial feature surge — if p95 latency increases > 25% and error rate doubles in 30m, throttle feature traffic to 10% and revert model variant. Notify SRE, PM, and Solutions-Eng.
- Playlet B: Data regression — if semantic accuracy drop >10% in eval suite during rollout, pause release, tag new commit for rollback, escalate to Applied ML.
- Playlet C: Billing anomaly — if daily cost > 2x forecasted for 24h, enable emergency cost cap for affected model endpoints and reduce batch size.

COMMUNICATION & ESCALATION STAIRS
- Level 0: Owner updates channel (#launch-window) with lightweight status.
- Level 1: Major deviation (alert threshold hit) — PM triage call in 15m, SRE joins.
- Level 2: Outage patterns — Incident bridge, exec notice, external status page update.

SINGLE-SHEET LAUNCH PRIORITY (weekly sprint cut)
- Fill columns: Feature | Composite score | RAG | Canary size | Ready? (Y/N) | Must-have for go-live? (Y/N) | Rollback plan link | Owner
- Example rows (fill during review):
  - routing-smart-fallback | 9 | Green | 5% | Y | Y | docs/rollback-routing.md | Marcus Lee
  - console-metrics-panel | 4 | Amber | 2% beta | N | N | docs/rollback-console.md | Sofia Nguyen
  - model-quantization-ops | 0 | Red | 0 | N | N | docs/rollback-quant.md | Ravi Patel

POST-LAUNCH 72H POCKET CHECK (place in on-call brief)
- Hour 0–6: watch p95 latency, error spike, and sserg (user-facing errors) every 30m.
- 6–24h: monitor adoption, confirm no customer-critical regressions, run short post-deploy eval set.
- 24–72h: confirm KPI projection trending toward 30-day target or open rollback if compounded failures.

NOTES & OPEN QUESTIONS (working space)
- Does the Beta cohort need an extended 2-week window for console features? (PM to decide)
- Ops: need a small automation to flip flags based on traffic thresholds — backlog ticket created (JIRA:POPS-861).
- SRE: confirm cost model for peak traffic; if >25% forecast we require sales signoff for billed customers.

APPENDIX: quick scoring cheat sheet
- Customer impact: 5 = directly increases DAU or retention; 3 = improves conversion; 1 = internal-only.
- Implementation risk: 5 = cross-team infra + >2 sprints; 3 = single-team with some infra; 1 = trivial.
- Time-to-value: use sprint windows: 5 = in current sprint, 3 = next sprint, 1 = >2 sprints.

---
Owner note: This is intentionally compact so PMs and Eng leads can complete tiles in 10–15 minutes during the triage meeting. After the first loop use the single-sheet launch priority to drive the final go/no-go checklist.
